section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) that was part of a wider Portuguese project. Participants were recruited online and completed self-report questionnaires; the initial sample was 509 individuals (352 women, 157 men) and, after exclusions, the selected sample comprised 309 Portuguese women aged 18–50 years.
